collection.name: Fleet Drive AI Demo Priority A Drivers
collection.visualFoundation: Realistic professional fleet-workplace profile photography with consistent head-and-shoulders framing, eye-level camera, soft natural professional lighting, natural expression, practical unbranded clothing, subtle uncluttered fleet or logistics context, and circular-avatar safe composition.
collection.identityPolicy: Driver names are fictional application identifiers only. Appearance variation is assigned independently of names and must not be treated as a depiction of a real person or as an inference about protected or sensitive characteristics.
collection.variationPolicy: Keep one coherent photographic system while varying fictional facial appearance, hairstyle, age presentation, practical wardrobe, pose, and subtle workplace background detail independently of each driver name.

postFreezeAmendments.notes: Controlled post-freeze identity and current-vehicle reconciliation. This does not change the 15-driver Priority A simulator set.

drivers.generationPrompt: Create a realistic square professional profile photograph of a wholly fictional adult fleet professional for a fleet-management Demo. This is not a real person and must not resemble a celebrity or public figure. Use head-and-shoulders framing, an eye-level camera, a natural calm expression, soft even professional lighting, and circular-avatar safe margins. Give this fictional variation a mid-career presentation, short textured hair, a plain navy polo, and a softly blurred fleet-depot office background. Keep the face as the clear focus. Use no text, logos, branding, licence cards, watermarks, identifiable vehicle model, or dramatic cinematic styling.
negativeConstraints: no real-person or celebrity resemblance
no text, logos, company branding, or watermark
no visible licence, ID card, badge, or name tag
no police, military, government uniform, or insignia
no identifiable assigned vehicle or readable third-party advertising
no cartoon, illustration, fashion editorial, passport-photo, or cinematic treatment
no exaggerated expression, cluttered background, or anatomy artifacts
drivers.crop: head and shoulders with circular-avatar safe area
